ms.report:
Milestone 2 – Tokenomics Modelling & Smart-Contract Verification
This milestone outlines the design and testing of the core smart contracts for the Amnesty DAO governance system and Human Rights Token reward logic.
It demonstrates that the soulbound_governance.ak (governance SBT mint policy) and oracle_rewards.ak (oracle-authorised reward validator) contracts meet Milestone 2 requirements for accuracy, functionality, security, and scalability.
All Aiken test suites passed successfully, confirming authorised minting, correct ownership recording, and oracle-verified reward distribution with no leakage or counterfeit tokens. Execution-unit data shows both scripts operate efficiently within Cardano protocol limits, capable of scaling to support Amnesty DAO’s global membership proof-of-concept.
Two independent external audits verified these results:
・Dr Sagar Dake (PhD, AUT NZ) – comprehensive technical review of contract logic and serialization/nonce handling
・Cherese Eriepa (Software Engineer / Ops Lead) – unit-test verification, authorisation logic, and execution-unit analysis

No critical or major vulnerabilities were identified; all minor notes were resolved. This confirms the system’s readiness for Milestone 3 (MVP prototype and user testing).
Supporting Documentation

・ https://github.com/Sugarlicks/AmnestyDAO-Token/tree/main/Tokenomics%20Model%20and%20Technical%20Report
・External Audits ›

ms.report:
Statement on Review Inconsistency and Request for Clarification
We note a material inconsistency between the two Milestone 3 reviews.
One review provides a clear, structured, and criteria-based assessment, confirming that the milestone outputs have been delivered in line with the published acceptance criteria. The second review, by contrast, is high-level, lacks specificity, and does not map its conclusions to any identifiable acceptance criteria.
This creates a fundamentally unclear assessment position:
・The same body of work is accepted as complete under one review
・While the other review does not clearly identify which specific requirements are unmet

In its current form, the second review does not provide sufficient detail to determine what corrective action, if any, is required. General statements regarding “scattered evidence” without reference to defined criteria are not actionable and do not meet the standard expected for milestone validation.
For avoidance of doubt, all Milestone 3 acceptance criteria have been addressed and evidenced, including:
・Delivery of a functional DAO MVP supporting proposals, voting, and participation
・Completion of a user testing phase with documented stakeholder feedback
・Integration of token-based participation and governance mechanisms
・Documentation of system architecture, deployment, and validation processes
・Public availability of all artefacts via GitHub

To support straightforward verification, all core materials have been consolidated into a clearly labelled directory. The Milestone 3 Evidence folder contains the core validation artefacts (including pilot feedback and analysis), with additional technical evidence (codebase, testing, and system documentation) available via the directly linked repository sections in the evidence mapping below.

Milestone 3 Evidence Folder:
https://github.com/Sugarlicks/AmnestyDAO-Token/tree/main/milestone-3-evidence
